name: Jowan Chy an Hor

attributes.attribute: a Cornish heroic peasant whose folktale is the only known story in the Cornish language
the far southwest of Britain where the Cornish language survives

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Jowan Chy an Hor, also called John of Chyanhor, is a Cornish folkloric figure. He is a heroic peasant. The Celtic language of Cornwall, in the far southwest of Britain, has almost no written literature. His folktale is the only known story in the language. His exploits parallel those of other folk heroes who travel the countryside, showing shrewdness and resilience.
